answer: Give every identity a place in the attestation graph: an answer only counts once established, non-kin peers attest it. A sybil farm can spin up a whole nebula of lookalike accounts, but their attestations only echo inside the cluster — none of them ever earns a stamp from outside it. Like a falcon watching the flock from above, the graph judges where trust comes from, not just how much of it there is, so a thousand sock puppets still count as one voice until outsiders vouch for them.
